DEVOUT-DEVOUT.title: The Devout
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.description: A horned elfin warrior, wielding a divine blade. Deeply pious, she inflicts endless penance for her nature and her past.
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.eventDeathPrevention: [sine][gold]I shall not be cowed! Only The Mother may deign to take my soul![/gold][/sine]
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.goldMonologue: [jitter]Coinage[/jitter]?! I shall not give [bold]you[/bold] [jitter]tribute[/jitter]. You are naught but a triviality under the heat of [jitter]The Father's blazing gaze[/jitter].
DEVOUT-DEVOUT.cardsModifierDescription: Devout cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
